turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, thanks for contacting support. What seems to be the problem?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The headphones I bought a month ago stopped working. The left side is completely dead.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sorry to hear that. Have you tried resetting them as described in the manual?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, twice. Nothing changes, the left side stays silent.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Understood, that sounds like a hardware fault. They are under warranty, so I can arrange a replacement.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That would be good. How does it work?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I will email you a return label. Once the carrier scans the package, the replacement ships automatically.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, a bit annoying to be without them, but fair enough.
